name: Aurelia Linen Weekender Bag
shortDescription: Hand-finished linen and leather bag for effortless travel.
description: Woven from heavyweight Belgian linen and trimmed in full-grain leather, the Weekender is built for a two-day escape or a daily commute. A reinforced base panel and brass hardware mean it will only look better with age.

name: Ember Ceramic Pour-Over Set
shortDescription: Matte stoneware carafe and filter cone for slow mornings.
description: Thrown in small batches, the Ember set pairs a double-walled stoneware carafe with a precision filter cone that keeps water temperature stable for an even extraction. Dishwasher safe, but it deserves better.

name: Solstice Merino Wrap Coat
shortDescription: Double-faced merino wool coat with horn buttons.
description: Cut from double-faced merino wool milled in Italy, the Solstice coat wraps and ties at the waist for a silhouette that works over everything from tailoring to weekend denim. Fully lined in cupro.

name: Lumen Brass Desk Lamp
shortDescription: Adjustable brass task lamp with a warm dimmable LED.
description: A solid brass arm and a hand-spun shade house a dimmable LED module rated for 30,000 hours. The Lumen lamp is weighted at the base so it stays put through every late-night deadline.

name: Marchetti Leather Card Holder
description: Six card slots and a centre pocket for folded notes, cut from a single piece of vegetable-tanned Tuscan leather that develops a rich patina with use.

name: Haven Wool Throw Blanket
shortDescription: Oversized lambswool throw, woven in a herringbone weave.
description: Woven on century-old looms from 100% lambswool, the Haven throw is generously sized at 130 x 180cm so it drapes over the largest of sofas without pulling short at the ends.

name: Aurelia Signature Candle
shortDescription: Amber, cedarwood and fig soy-wax candle, 60hr burn.
description: Our signature scent, poured by hand into a reusable amber glass vessel. Notes of fig leaf and cedarwood open into a warm amber base with an approximate 60-hour burn time.

name: Voss Cashmere Beanie
description: Knit from pure Mongolian cashmere in a classic ribbed pattern, the Voss beanie folds neatly at the brim and holds its shape through a full winter of wear.
